propositions: Whitespace-only edits (trailing spaces, leading newlines) to no_file_impact_reason produce different material fingerprints and cause signed attestations to report stale-material, violating the documented whitespace-normalization invariant.
material_basis() canonicalizes description but inserts no_file_impact_reason raw byte-for-byte when file_impact_scope is 'none', making boundary whitespace changes material when they should not be.
Legacy fingerprint candidates for pre-330c (raw) and post-330c/pre-2be7 (checkbox-normalized) must preserve raw reason hashing to maintain compatibility with historical attestations.

Post-2be7 attestations with canonical descriptions and raw reasons require an explicit third legacy candidate with normalize_reason=False to grandfather unchanged after the fix applies reason normalization to current fingerprints.
Interior whitespace changes and substantive word edits to no_file_impact_reason must remain material and produce stale-material verdicts after the fix.
